text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A full season had passed since
my last conversation with Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On that day, I was walking along a path lined with cherry blossoms toward a certain destination—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And they're off to a clean start!
The short-distance clash on the 1000m turf has officially begun!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A fierce battle for position is unfolding!
This is bound to be a chaotic fray!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...My hands instinctively clench tight. I can feel my heart racing.
And with that, the memory of our exchange from "that day" comes rushing back—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However—I must respectfully decline.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was disappointing. But there was nothing I could do.
Respecting Ikuno Dictus's wishes, I began to—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—As I am now, I am simply not worthy.
...Please grant me three months of time.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Through all the mock races thus far, I have finally managed to glimpse it:
the path to victory with the highest probability for an inexperienced runner like myself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will demonstrate this in the Debut Selection Race three months from now.
Therefore, I ask that you first... observe that race before making your final judgment.
choice_data_list: Wait, does that mean... in other words...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—I felt it would be unfair otherwise. I have yet to demonstrate
my genuine capabilities in an actual race to you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Because you stated you wished to support my goal...
I want to prove that I am a horsegirl capable of winning, and answer your sincerity in kind.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Would that be acceptable?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My answer had already been set in stone—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Passing the 600m mark! Still clustered in a tight pack! Who will break away?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (—I am by no means an inherently powerful horsegirl.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Here at Tracen Academy, there are countless magnificent horsegirls
who boast overwhelming natural talent.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(For me to compete on the same stage where they run...
I have no choice but to maximize my strengths to the absolute limit and pierce through with that single point.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"—As expected, Ikuno-kun,
you possess an extraordinary talent for management."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Talent, you say? What sort of talent could that possibly—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"A 'will' as firm and unyielding as iron. Once you set your mind to a task, you see it through without fail.
You possess an indomitable spirit. That is the greatest strength in management."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"When you eventually find a goal you truly wish to achieve, use that 'will' of yours
to advance steadily, step by step. You will surely be able to accomplish any goal you set."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(—In order to win this Debut Selection Race today,
I ran numerous mock races and grasped the strongest form of running I can currently achieve.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The more iron is struck, the stronger it becomes.
Now is the time to demonstrate my strength—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus bursts out of the pack!
She charges to the front!! What tremendous speed!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: —And they cross the line!! Taking first place is number 2, Ikuno Dictus!!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—That was incredible speed, Ikuno Dictus!
With running like that, won't you aim for the GⅠ stage with me?!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That was an exquisite race execution. If you're willing,
would you consider aiming for the top under my guidance?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: —I want to help you run longer than anyone else!
—I want to help you run longer than anyone else!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: And I want to help you win more than anyone else! So—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I walk up to Ikuno Dictus.
Then, with a resolve just as strong as hers, I speak.
choice_data_list: Please let me be your Trainer.
Please let me be your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
.........Yes, it would be my pleasure.
I look forward to working with you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the handshake I shared with Ikuno Dictus
became an unbreakable vow—
